notes.subject: תתמך/יתמכו
notes.rationale: same verb תמך in both halves — the parallelism is kept by repeating 'mara' in Bambara.

notes.subject: עריצים
notes.rationale: 'terrible/violent ones' — rendered 'fanga-jugubagaw' (violent-power people); some read 'strong men' without the tyranny shade.

notes.subject: tigi
notes.rationale: Bambara needs agent-suffix 'ɲɛfɛntigi' (favor-holder) where Hebrew אשת חן is a bound construct 'woman of grace'.

translation: Muso ɲɛfɛntigi bɛ sumaya mara; nka fanga-jugubagaw bɛ wari mara.
